IncidentDescription: Rear-ended at a traffic signal on Outer Ring Road, Bengaluru. Rear bumper, tailgate and tail lamps damaged.
Left side of the car struck by an autorickshaw at the Indiranagar 100 Feet Road junction. Front left door, fender and mirror damaged.
Head-on collision with a road divider at high speed on Hosur Road. Front bumper, bonnet, radiator, headlamps and airbags damaged.
